INTRODUCTION

This publication contains symbols developed for small-scale maps or plans for which the symbols given in the other parts would not be quite suitable. The latter may however be used as well.

On maps, the centre of a symbol, such as those of sections instance, shall correspond with the exact location. The symbol size may be varied to suit the application.
